fields.title: 📖 Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal on the created Qurʾān
fields.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Whoever says that the Qurʾān is created is, with us, a Kāfir; for the Qurʾān belongs to the Knowledge of Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah does not separate reverence for Allah from reverence for His revealed Word.

immutable.source: 📝 ʿAbdullāh ibn Aḥmad, Kitāb as-Sunnah; zitiert bei Islamweb, Fatwā Nr. 220654.
